gaps.lead: The athlete denied taking performance-enhancing drugs.
gaps.explanation: deny + having + past participle (or deny taking).

gaps.lead: Their wedding will take place in June.
gaps.explanation: Weddings/concerts are held: will be held (in June).

gaps.lead: You won't get a seat unless you book.
You must sign the form in ink.
gaps.explanation: sign the form in ink → the form must be signed in ink.

gaps.lead: She'll be at work, so she won't answer the door.
gaps.sentence: She'll be at work, so ___ answer the door.
gaps.explanation: won't be able to = future inability.

gaps.lead: He is so impatient that he never reads instructions.
gaps.explanation: so impatient that he never reads = too impatient to read.
